verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments SaaS that holds user and agent data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, data export or deletion API, or account-data erasure. Account deactivation (it only stops new token creation) and selective disclosure of identity fields in tokens are adjacent features, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
